summary: Do not treat a Proxy around an Error as Error-branded for Error.isError.

semantics.proxy: Proxy object does not itself carry target [[ErrorData]]
semantics.result: false even when target is an Error
semantics.traps: brand check does not call user Proxy traps

tests.name: proxy traps not consulted
tests.input: let n=0; const p=new Proxy(new Error(),{get(){n++;}}); console.log(Error.isError(p),n)
